Install in a minute

A small extra step
for the free test build.

Stickyy is currently distributed without Apple’s paid Developer ID notarization. macOS therefore asks you to approve the first launch yourself.

  1. 1

    Drag into Applications

    Open the DMG and drag the Stickyy icon onto the Applications folder.

  2. 2

    Try to open Stickyy

    If macOS blocks it, choose Done—do not move the app to Trash.

  3. 3

    Approve the first launch

    Open System Settings → Privacy & Security, click Open Anyway beside Stickyy, then confirm Open.

This approval is needed only once. Future launches work normally.
